thread:
tess: Quick idea: can we add a lightweight 'simulate rollout' in Console to preview perf + cost before changing runtime config? :question:
omar: yes. currently dry-run is opinionated. we need sampled traffic replay + a fallback modeled estimate for sensitive tenants.
li: Constraints: no doubling of live requests, scrub PII, region/tenant exclude. Also must surface confidence intervals.
mika: UX: two toggles in modal: 'Sampled replay' (sends 1-5% mirror) and 'Modelled estimate' (uses perf profiles). show p50/p95 delta, error delta, cost delta, and sample size.
ops-bot: runbook: "If runner reports backend_saturation > 0.6 -> auto-pause simulation, alert #eng-oncall, mark result INCONCLUSIVE."
omar: API sketch:
```
POST /internal/config/simulate
{ "config_id": "route_defaults_v4", "mode": "mirror", "sample_pct": 2, "window_min": 30, "exclude_regions": ["eu-west-1"] }
```
li: Telemetry contract: emit 'config_sim_summary' with tags: config_id, mode, sample_pct, p50_delta_ms, p95_delta_ms, err_delta_ppm, cost_estimate_usd, confidence_low/high, sample_count. stream to 'config-observability'.
tess: Safety predicate proposal: allow rollout only if p95_delta_ms < 20 && err_delta_ppm < 300 && cost_delta_pct < 8. Expose predicate as part of rollout API.
mika: For privacy, we should mask user identifiers and honor tenant consent flags; if consent missing, simulator must fall back to modelled estimate.
omar: Runner ownership: i'll take the runner + rate-limiting. will add saturation probes and tenant-consent checks.
li: i'll own telemetry and the dashboard widget. will add the pass/fail badge and CI-style history.
tess: i'll do the console modal + audit logging (who ran simulation). include link to raw summary.
ops-bot: reminder: all simulation requests must be logged to audit trail with initiator, time, config_id.
mika: pinging legal for GDPR phrasing for tenant-consent.
tess: great. i'll draft the API PR and console mock tomorrow morning. if anyone has quick objections to the predicate thresholds call them out now. :eyes:
li: looks reasonable, maybe tighten p95 to 15ms for latency-sensitive routes.
omar: let's land with 20ms then iterate after a couple of runs.
